title: Seismique Immersive Art Experience Ticket
includes: Admission to all interactive art exhibits
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Beware the Lightstorms: Some realms shimmer and flash. Those sensitive to light should tread carefully.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Seismique invites visitors into a realm of creativity and exploration with its immersive art installations and unique attractions. Engage with dazzling hands-on exhibits that spark imagination, enjoy a round of glow-in-the-dark mini-golf coming December 20th, or have fun at the arcade featuring air hockey and VR experiences. The Cosmique Café provides refreshments to enhance your visit. For those looking to host private events, the venue offers a vibrant space perfect for gatherings. Experience the fusion of art and entertainment at Seismique, where every corner offers a new adventure.
